_metadata.schema_update: Added a field for Project URL text to display as hyperlinked on the page

placement.section: Choose one: Web, Print, Digital, or Video
placement.sub_section: Chose one; use an already used sub_section tag if possible, otherwise create one: HTML/CSS/JS, Webflow, Framer, Application

technology: ARRAY; each tag should be in its own set of quotes; Choose as many as are needed; only create new tags when absolutely necessary: Webflow, CMS, Framer, JavaScript, Python Script, CSS, HTML, JSON, Markdown, Agentic, AI, Generative, Make.com, Notion API, GitHub Pages, Jekyll, Responsive, Mobile-First, Creative Cloud, Adobe Firefly, Photoshop In-painting, Lottie, Git
media: ARRAY; each tag should be in its own set of quotes; Choose as many as are needed; only create new tags when absolutely necessary: Progressive Web App,Single Page Application,Analytics Dashboard,SaaS,Landing Page,Digital Product,Mobile App,SMS,Social Media,Email,NFT,Voice Interface,Blog,Website,Template,Portfolio,E-Commerce,Podcast,Web App,Deck Presentation,Digital Art,Print,Baroque
tagging.role: STRING; Choose ONE; there will be instances where the appropriate tag does not yet exist and a new one should only be created when it is the absolute most appropriate, encompassing role for that specific project entry; This value will be used as the first element of four sections on every project entry page; choose from: Web Developer, App Developer, Creative Director, Digital Consultant, Graphic Designer
skill: ARRAY; each tag should be in its own set of quotes; Choose as many as are needed; only create new tags when absolutely necessary: Animation, Content Production, Typography, Graphic Design, Publishing, Illustration, Copywriting, Fashion Photography, Product Staging, Optimization, Automation, Scaling System, Publishing, System Design, Conversation Design, UX/UI Writing, User Design, Advertising, Marketing, Art History, Branding, Account Management, No-Code Development, Front-End, Back-End, Full-Stack, DRY Principles, Modularity, Product, Web Design

media.video_filename: OPTIONAL; add only if there is a video embed
media.video_url: OPTIONAL; if the project has a video on YouTube, use this type of URL https://youtu.be/lnoKsXWa584
media.video_embed: OPTIONAL; provide if the project has a YouTube video; adjust the embed code provided here by changing the 'src' URL, and the 'TITLE' value; change nothing else: <iframe width='560' height='315' src='https://www.youtube.com/embed/lnoKsXWa584?si=1bdNy9s8d65d5Kme&controls=0' title='Automated Webflow CMS Shop and Fashion Gallery' frameborder='0' allow='accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share' referrerpolicy='strict-origin-when-cross-origin' allowfullscreen></iframe>
media.video_alt_text: Provide if you provided a video embed
thumbnail_images: REQUIRED: ARRAY of > 2 and < 9 compressed .webp image files that have all been cropped and sized to 1920px X 1080px at 73 resolution; filename and relative URL should resemble: assets/media/automated-e-commerce-shop-lookbook/thumb-slides-automated-e-commerce-shop-lookbook-1.webp

assets.project_url_text: If you have a project URL, create a simple, easy-to-read version of the URL, as in the example, for `content.assets.project_url_text`
assets.project_url: If available, provide a URL to any detailed post about the project
assets.github_repository: If available, provide a URL to the GitHub repository for the project

teaser_copy.page_title: REQUIRED; short, simple version of the SEO title
teaser_copy.page_subtitle: REQUIRED; space for the extra context that needed to be pulled to shorten the title
teaser_copy.breadcrumb: REQUIRED; super simple and short so that it can come after the section, sub_section, on every entry page
tile_text: REQUIRED; ARRAY of ~4 lines of text, each ~7 words long; these are teasers displayed below the thumbnail images

page_copy.pattern: REQUIRED; one small paragraph; concise and get to the point; it will be the second section on every project entry page; maximum of 500 words
page_copy.action: REQUIRED; one small paragraph; concise and get to the point; it will be the third section on every project entry page; maximum of 500 words
page_copy.measured: REQUIRED; one small paragraph; concise and get to the point; it will be the fourth section on every project entry page; maximum of 500 words
